name: Printers
author: omarchy-maker
description: Your 3D printers in the bar: the running print, time left, temperatures, and a notification when it finishes or fails. Klipper (Moonraker) and Bambu Lab printers on your network.

barWidget.description: The running print and time left in the bar; every printer in the panel. Add printers with: maker printer add (Klipper) or maker printer add-bambu (Bambu Lab)
